Unofficial JSON endpoints behind gubanovfiles.com ("Files of Gubanov"), a database of bloggers and outlets that published promotional material about the 'SEZ PPT Alabuga' project. Knowledge comes from the community Swift client https://github.com/l0v3m0n3y/gubanovfiles (src/gubanovfiles.swift lists the three routes) and from live GET probes on 2026-10-23; the site publishes no documentation of its own. Response shapes are taken from those probes. Unverified: `/statuses` returned an empty object, so its contents are unknown; no pagination or query parameters were observed on any route. No key is needed.
